text: Maybe the guys are holding a person on a stretcher above them? Maybe this is the day of the Cambodian picking up the detonator to return to me?
researchNotes: A tentative second look — 'maybe', twice — linking the frame to the day of VN-0157. Recorded as his association, not adopted as the caption.
